output.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund (OPEF) manages the stipend process for about 27 LIFE Academy student interns in the summer ECCCO (Exploring College, Career, and Community Options) work-based learning program. Each student gets $500, and the total includes OPEF's indirect costs. The agreement runs March 9 through May 28, 2026.

output.headline: Approves Kids 1st Foundation's $69,000 historically Black colleges trip for McClymonds students

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $69,000.00

output.summary: The Kids 1st Foundation arranged travel and lodging for 25 McClymonds High School students and 4 staff to visit seven historically Black colleges and universities, including airfare, charter bus, hotel, meals and cultural excursions. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 6, 2026.

output.headline: Approves Landmark Educational Tours' $67,000 six-day East Coast trip for Fremont High students

money.evidence: at a cost not to exceed $67,000.00

output.summary: Landmark Educational Tours, of Middleton, Massachusetts, creates a customized six-day student trip to Washington, DC, Virginia and North Carolina for Fremont High School. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 1, 2026 and runs through June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $14,300 to manage summer intern stipends at Sojourner Truth

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $14,300.00

output.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund manages the stipend process for paid summer work-based learning opportunities for 13 high school students at Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program. The agreement runs June 1 through June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $34,000 for newcomer student support at Castlemont High

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $34,000.00

output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources provides intensive support for Newcomer students at Castlemont High School, including one-on-one check-ins, tracking of attendance and grades, family communication, and help with immigration-related issues. The goal is better attendance and progress toward graduation. The agreement runs January 15 through June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Approves space80sevenllc's $58,000 music industry internship program for Fremont High Media Academy

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $58,000.00

output.summary: space80sevenllc runs an eight-week internship-style program on the business of music media for ten Fremont High School Media Academy students. It includes mentorship from industry professionals and career field trips, including a two-day externship in Los Angeles. The Board is approving the agreement after the fact (ratifying it); its term began February 1, 2026.

output.headline: Authorizes 63 Oakland Tech seniors to travel to the Oregon Shakespeare Festival in April
output.summary: This resolution lets Oakland Technical High School take sixty-three 12th grade students to the Oregon Shakespeare Festival in Ashland, Oregon, from April 15 through April 17, 2026. The agenda lists no fiscal impact for the district.

output.headline: Adds $59.1M to C. Overaa & Company's contract to build the Coliseum College Prep expansion

money.evidence: in an additional amount of $59,101,431.00

output.summary: This amendment sets the final Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) for the full Coliseum College Preparatory Academy site expansion, including a new two-story classroom building and demolition of the existing gymnasium. It adds $59,101,431 and raises the design-builder contract's not-to-exceed total from $3,273,398 to $62,374,829.

output.headline: Adopts changes to Board Bylaw 9322 on agenda and meeting materials
output.summary: The Board is adopting an amendment to Board Bylaw 9322, which covers agendas and meeting materials. The changes are shown in a red-lined version in Exhibit A of the item.

output.headline: Approves the minutes of the March 11, 2026 regular Board of Education meeting
output.summary: The Board is ratifying (formally approving) the written minutes of its regular meeting held March 11, 2026. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after that meeting.

output.headline: Approves Measure G1 funding applications for named schools, as recommended by the oversight commission
output.summary: This resolution adopts the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to approve 2026-2027 Measure G1 applications, amended 2025-2026 applications, and a 2024-2025 carryover funding request for named schools. Measure G1 funds teacher retention and middle school improvement. The item text does not list dollar amounts or the schools.
